minimal-still-needs-a-way-out.description: A minimal manual, centred on real tasks, taught faster than a standard manual in a study of 64 students, but beginners still need error-recovery material, which is why every step has a Stuck? help [1][2].

four-pieces-one-chain.title: Four steps, one chain
four-pieces-one-chain.script: Here is the whole route in four steps: a terminal, an AI agent, a folder and a skill. Each step only works because the one before it works, so when the last one runs, you know the whole chain holds. It takes about twenty minutes. Tick what you already have, and the card on the right tells you which step to start at.

skip-what-you-have.title: Skip what you have
skip-what-you-have.script: Tick the boxes you already have, like an installed AI agent, and the card jumps you to the first step that is still open. And if you would rather build the setup yourself than download it, the last Section is for you, so skip to the end.
